title: MAR test (antisperm antibodies)
what: In the lab, sperm are checked under a microscope to see if antibodies are stuck to them. These antibodies make it hard for sperm to move and fertilize an egg.
why: For a couple's infertility, if sperm clump together or move poorly on a semen analysis, and after injury or surgery on the testicles.
duration: giving the sample usually takes 10 to 20 minutes; results usually come the same or next day
tell_doctor: If you had injuries, surgery, or inflammation of the testicles or prostate
If you had an illness with fever in the last 2 to 3 months

prepare.title: Abstinence
prepare.text: Usually 2 to 7 days without ejaculation. The lab will tell you the exact time.

prepare.title: Before the test
prepare.text: For several days: no alcohol, steam baths, or sauna.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop anything on your own. Tell your doctor what you take.

prepare.title: Together
prepare.text: The MAR test is often done together with a semen analysis from the same sample.

steps: You get a sterile container and are shown to a private room
Wash your hands and penis with soap
Collect all of the semen into the container by masturbating
Close the container and hand it to the staff
The sample is checked under a microscope right away
feel: It often feels awkward. That is normal. The staff are used to it
after: Results usually come the same or next day
If there are a lot of antibodies, the doctor will explain the options for conceiving

faq.q: Can I collect the sample at home?
faq.a: Sometimes it is allowed, if you can bring it in warm within a short time. Ask the lab about the rules.

faq.q: Can I use a condom to collect it?
faq.a: Not a regular one. It contains substances that harm sperm. Use only the container from the lab.

reminders.text: MAR test in 2 days. No ejaculation for the time the lab told you. No alcohol or steam baths.
